title: CI legs: Windows separators + Linux viewport
desiredOutcome: CI run on main is fully green: j12 passes on Windows because journal_dir returns one normalized spelling everywhere (proven red-first on POSIX via the root-manifest ./ case), and the policy view fits the raised capture viewport on Linux.
summary: The first honest CI run over the backlog found both platform assumptions and both are paid: journal_dir normalizes its return (a2b red-first proved the class on POSIX before Windows ever re-ran), and the capture viewport carries Linux-font headroom. Ubuntu legs verified locally-equivalent; the Windows leg's verdict is the re-run's to give.
